title: cosmos deficiens
intro: Cosmos deficiens, commonly known as the Pink Cosmos or Dwarf Cosmos, is a perennial plant native to North America. The plant is used for its medicinal properties and offers various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cosmos deficiens include promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and exerting a sedative effect. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
